description:
Check connectivity to Datafordeleren (DAR) and report which access paths are configured.

Returns: whether the legacy REST service answers (and its latency), whether an API key for the GraphQL service is configured, the REST sunset date (2027-01-15; after it only API-key/OAuth access exists), and the attribution text that must accompany the data (CC BY 4.0, Klimadatastyrelsen).

Use first when a DAR call fails unexpectedly, or to decide whether text search (dar_search_addresses, needs API key) is available.
name: dar_status
title: DAR connection status
